name: AverForm – Contact Form Builder, Drag & Drop WordPress Form Plugin
author: Md. Kamrul Hasan

sections.description:
AverForm is a fast, modern drag and drop WordPress form builder

AverForm is a lightweight contact form plugin for WordPress built around a real drag and drop form builder. Add a field, drop it where you want it, edit it in the side panel, and publish — no shortcode juggling, no page reloads, and no code.

Every form you build comes with submission storage, CSV export, email notifications, spam protection and a visual reporting dashboard out of the box, in the free plugin. Nothing is locked behind an upsell.

Whether you need a simple WordPress contact form, a feedback form, a support request form, a newsletter signup, an NPS survey or a lead generation form, AverForm gives you the fields and the workflow to ship it in minutes.

Everything AverForm Gives You

  • Drag and drop form builder with a live canvas
  • 30+ ready-to-use form fields
  • Ready-made form templates (contact, support, newsletter, blank)
  • Multi-column form layouts with adjustable column widths
  • Undo / redo and full form edit history in the builder
  • Desktop, tablet and mobile responsive preview
  • Live form preview on a real frontend page
  • Complete entry (submission) management — read, unread, favorite, trash, restore
  • Bulk actions and entry search
  • Export form entries to CSV
  • Export and import forms as JSON, plus one-click form duplication
  • Email notifications with dynamic smart codes
  • Success message or redirect URL after submit
  • Built-in honeypot spam protection on every form
  • Reporting dashboard with charts, submission trends and per-field breakdowns
  • Per-entry diagnostics — source page, browser, device and user agent
  • Global defaults for label placement and validation messages
  • GDPR-friendly data cleanup control on uninstall
  • Fully translation ready (.pot file included)
  • No jQuery, no bloat — assets load only on pages that actually show a form

Drag & Drop Contact Form Builder

The AverForm builder is a modern React application, not a page of settings screens. Drag any field from the palette onto the canvas, reorder it by dragging, and configure it in the inspector on the right.

  • Drag to add, drag to reorder, click to configure
  • Multi-column containers so fields can sit side by side
  • Undo and redo every change, with edit history
  • Switch between desktop, tablet and mobile preview while you build
  • Per-field label placement, placeholder, help text, description and custom error message
  • Separate admin label for each field, used in entries and CSV exports

30+ WordPress Form Fields

General fields

  • Name (first, middle, last — each toggleable)
  • Email
  • Simple Text
  • Masked Input
  • Text Area
  • Number
  • Website URL
  • Password
  • Phone / Mobile Number
  • Address (street, city, state, zip, country)
  • Country List (with flags, searchable, include or exclude countries)
  • Dropdown / Select
  • Radio
  • Checkbox
  • Multiple Choice (multi-select)
  • Date & Time
  • File Upload
  • Image Upload
  • Hidden Field

Advanced fields

  • Rating
  • NPS (Net Promoter Score)
  • Range Slider
  • Color Picker
  • Signature
  • Rich Text Editor
  • Repeater Field

Layout fields

  • Section Break
  • Custom HTML
  • Column Container (multi-column layout)
  • Custom Submit Button

Consent fields

  • Terms & Conditions
  • GDPR Agreement

Ready-Made Form Templates

Skip the blank page. Start from a template and adjust it:

  • Blank Form
  • Contact Form
  • Support Request
  • Newsletter Signup

Every template ships pre-wired with an admin email notification, so a new form is genuinely usable the moment you publish it.

Form Entries & Submission Management

All submissions are stored in your own database — you own your data, and nothing is sent to a third-party service.

  • Read / unread status with counts
  • Mark entries as favorite
  • Trash and restore, or delete permanently
  • Bulk actions across selected entries
  • Search across submission content
  • Full entry detail view with every submitted value
  • Submission context: source page URL, browser, operating system, device and raw user agent
  • One-click CSV export of a form’s entries

Built-in Reports & Analytics

AverForm ships with a real reporting dashboard, not just a submission counter.

  • Total submissions, spam, unread and created forms at a glance
  • Period-over-period change indicators
  • Submission trend chart over time
  • Date ranges: last 7 days, last 30 days, this month, last month, last 90 days, this year
  • Top-performing forms
  • Per-field answer breakdowns for choice-based fields
  • Submission activity heatmap

Email Notifications with Smart Codes

Send an email whenever a form is submitted, and build the content dynamically:

  • Multiple notifications per form
  • Dynamic recipients, subject and body
  • Smart codes for {site.name}, {site.url}, {admin.email}, {date.now}, {form.title} and {all.fields}
  • Insert any submitted field value into the email
  • Clean, readable HTML email template

Spam Protection

Every AverForm form renders a honeypot field that traps automated bots. It is enabled by default, invisible to real visitors, needs no API keys, no configuration and no third-party service — and it never asks your visitors to solve a puzzle.

Privacy & GDPR Friendly

  • Built-in GDPR Agreement and Terms & Conditions consent fields
  • Submissions stay in your WordPress database — no external data processing
  • Optional Remove All Data on Uninstall setting that drops every AverForm table and option when you delete the plugin

Lightweight & Fast

AverForm’s frontend is deliberately small. There is no jQuery dependency, and the form CSS and JavaScript are registered but only enqueued on pages where a form is actually rendered — so pages without a form load exactly zero AverForm assets.

Developer Friendly

  • PSR-4 autoloaded, namespaced codebase following WordPress coding standards
  • Clean REST API namespace (averform/v1) for forms, entries, reports and settings
  • Extension points such as averform_register_fields and the averform/booted action to register your own field types
  • Custom database tables with a versioned schema
  • Fully translation ready with an included .pot file

Add a Form to Your Site

Publish a form and paste its shortcode anywhere — a post, a page, or a widget:

[averform id="1"]

The shortcode is shown next to every form in the AverForm → All Forms list, ready to copy.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for AverForm.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the averform folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.

After activation

  1. Go to AverForm → Add New and pick a template, or start from a blank form.
  2. Drag fields onto the canvas and configure them in the right-hand panel.
  3. Open Settings in the builder to set your email notification and your success message or redirect.
  4. Save the form, copy its shortcode from AverForm → All Forms, and paste it into any post or page.
  5. Watch submissions arrive under AverForm → Entries and track performance under AverForm → Reports.
sections.faq:
Do I need to know how to code to use AverForm?

No. AverForm is a no-code drag and drop form builder. You add fields by dragging them onto the canvas and configure everything from the settings panel. The only thing you ever copy and paste is the form’s shortcode.

How do I create a contact form in WordPress with AverForm?

Go to AverForm → Add New, choose the Contact Form template, adjust the fields if you want, save it, then paste the shortcode (for example [averform id="1"]) into the page where you want the form to appear. The template already includes an admin email notification, so you will be notified about submissions right away.

Will AverForm slow down my website?

No. AverForm has no jQuery dependency, and its frontend CSS and JavaScript are only enqueued on pages that actually render a form. Pages without a form load no AverForm assets at all.

Where are my form submissions stored?

In your own WordPress database, in AverForm’s own tables. Nothing is sent to an external service, and you can export any form’s entries to CSV at any time.

Can I export my form entries?

Yes. Open a form’s entries and click Export CSV to download every submission as a CSV file you can open in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets.

Can I move a form to another site?

Yes. Use Export on any form in the All Forms list to download it as a JSON file, then import that file on the other site. You can also Duplicate a form on the same site with one click.

Does AverForm stop spam submissions?

Yes. Every form includes a built-in honeypot trap that blocks automated bot submissions. It works automatically, requires no configuration or API keys, and never shows your visitors a CAPTCHA puzzle.

Can I build multi-column forms?

Yes. Drop a Column Container onto the canvas, choose how many columns you need, and adjust each column’s width. Fields placed inside sit side by side.

Can I collect file uploads?

Yes. AverForm includes both a File Upload field and an Image Upload field, with allowed file types and size limits you control per field.

Is AverForm GDPR friendly?

AverForm includes dedicated GDPR Agreement and Terms & Conditions consent fields, keeps all submission data inside your own database, and offers a Remove All Data on Uninstall setting so deleting the plugin can wipe every trace of its data.

Is AverForm translation ready?

Yes. All strings use the averform text domain and a .pot file is included in the languages folder, so the plugin can be translated into any language.

Can I add my own custom field type?

Yes. AverForm exposes a field registry with the averform_register_fields extension point and the averform/booted action, so a developer can register custom field types the same way the plugin registers its own advanced fields.

Where do I report a bug or request a feature?

Please open a thread in the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org. Bug reports and feature requests are both very welcome — AverForm is actively developed and new features are shipping regularly.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Improved
  • Added powerful conditional logic with flexible rule combinations and grouped-field support.
  • Added multi-step forms with customizable progress indicators and navigation labels.
  • Added a command palette for faster navigation and actions.
  • Added inline field insertion for a smoother form-building experience.
  • Added Dark Mode support with an easy top-bar toggle.
  • Enhanced Reports with date-range filtering and improved submission insights.
  • Added recent submission previews to the dashboard.
  • Improved the builder experience with unsaved-change protection.
  • Enhanced the template gallery with live previews and full-size previews.
  • Improved admin navigation, loading states, drag-and-drop, and form controls for a smoother experience.
  • Improved confirmation dialogs and overall UI consistency across the admin experience.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Drag and drop form builder with live canvas, undo/redo, edit history and responsive preview.
  • 30+ form fields across general, advanced, layout and consent categories.
  • Ready-made form templates: Blank, Contact Form, Support Request and Newsletter Signup.
  • Entry management with read/unread, favorites, trash, restore, bulk actions and search.
  • CSV export for form entries.
  • Form export, import and duplication.
  • Email notifications with smart codes and HTML email template.
  • Confirmation message or redirect after submission.
  • Built-in honeypot spam protection.
  • Reporting dashboard with charts, date ranges, top forms and per-field breakdowns.
  • Global settings for label placement, validation messages, spam and data cleanup on uninstall.
  • Translation ready with an included .pot file.
